The relief sought in this petition is for quashing of the F.I.R. dated 19.05.2023, registered as Case Crime No. 0197 of 2023, under Sections 420, 409, 467, 468, 471, 120B, 34 IPC, Police Station NOIDA Sector-58, NOIDA, District Gautam Budhha Nagar.
Further prayer has been made not to arrest the petitioners in the aforesaid case.

3. Submission of the learned counsel for the petitioners is that even perusal of the impugned first M/S Kakabazar Pvt.Ltd.And 5 Others vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/112745090/
1 information report would not reflect commission of any offence under the sections as alleged in the first information report.

4. Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for quashing of the FIR and submits that it is only for a direction from National Company Law Tribunal, New Delhi that the investigation is being conducted and the first information report has been lodged after due inquiry by the authority concerned under the provisions of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Submission,
therefore is that a cognizable offfence involving huge amount of money is made out.

5. We find that the first information report has been lodged by the Interim Resolution Professional appointed by the National Company Law Tribunal, New Delhi Bench vide order dated 13.12.2022 passed in CP (IB)460/ND/2021 to run the corporate insolvency resolution process under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016 and it is only after due inquiry the authority concerned under the provisions of Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016, has lodged the present first information report, which clearly discloses cognizable offence involving huge amount of money.
Therefore, in view of the law laid down by Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of State of Haryana and others vs. Bhajan Lal and others, 1992 Supp. (1) SCC 335 and M/s Neeharika Infrastructure Pvt.
Ltd. vs. State of Maharashtra, AIR 2021 SC 1918 and in Special Leave to Appeal (Crl.) No.3262/2021 (Leelavati Devi @ Leelawati & another vs. the State of Uttar Pradesh) decided on 07.10.2021, no case has been made out for interference with the impugned first information report.
6.
